AdminIpcClient.description:
One connected IPC client, as reported by `ipc_status`. Display identity
only — the socket's same-user permission check is the security boundary.

access.description: The session access this connection was granted.

protocol.description: The negotiated wire protocol revision (1 = legacy, no hello).

client_count.description: Number of clients currently connected to the host (0 when not hosting).

clients.description:
The connected clients, as their hellos introduced them; a protocol-1
(pre-hello) connection appears anonymous. Empty when not hosting.

hosting.description: True when this process is hosting a broker socket for other processes.

is_owner.description:
True when this process owns the store (holds the writer lock); false
when it is a client of another same-machine owner.

owner_pid.description: The hosting owner's process id, when known.

socket_path.description: The hosted (or connected) socket path, when one exists.

SessionAccess.description:
The access a session declares at hello. The owner's dispatch gate rejects
write-classified commands on a `Read` session; see the IPC evolution
design (`docs/architecture/ipc/ipc-evolution-design.md` §4.2).

oneOf.description: The session intends read-class commands only.
Full command access — the pre-hello default.

request.description:
Reports this process's multi-process IPC state (whether it hosts a
broker socket, the socket path, owner pid, and live client count).

response.description: Multi-process IPC state for this process.
